description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractThingCommandStrategy' that provides a base implementation for command strategies related to 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for validator retrieval, calculating relative metadata, and handling command definitions.

classes.name: AbstractThingCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for command strategies operating on 'Thing' entities, including metadata calculation and header validation.

methods.name: AbstractThingCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command strategy with the specific command class type.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Returns the validator used for conditional headers validation.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Calculates and returns relative metadata based on the given 'Thing' entity and command, considering optional entity data.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates whether the command is defined; unsupported in this implementation.
